players.product: Carbonate fuel-cell power plants (FuelCell Energy Blocks) for behind-the-meter baseload data-center power

quarterly_data.signal: Customer Fit Energy: FuelCell Energy's 8-K on its June 22, 2026 agreements with Fit Energy USA LP (a developer of reliable power solutions to support advanced computing infrastructure and artificial intelligence) ties three warrant tranches to Fit's deposits for further phases of 100 MW (phase 1), 125 MW (phase 2) and 125 MW (phase 3) of power generation platforms; the phase 1 non-refundable deposit equals 16% of the order value for 100 MW. The release describes a strategic agreement for up to 380 MW of clean, baseload on-site power for data centers, including an immediate deposit for an initial 30 MW scheduled to begin delivery later this year. CEO Jason Few: the agreement 'further validates our decision to scale our operations to 500 MW'.
quarterly_data.figure: phases of 100 MW, 125 MW and 125 MW beyond the initial 30 MW (up to 380 MW); phase 1 deposit 16% of order value
